# SINNVO (星沃)

> Custom villa and home elevators, designed, manufactured and installed by SINNVO in Huzhou, Zhejiang, China, for homes worldwide. Sales, R&D, manufacturing and installation are under one roof. SINNVO also makes elevator decoration components (cabin wall panels, ceilings, door panels, handrails) for other elevator manufacturers.

Legal name: Huzhou Jiangxin Shijie Elevator & Decoration Co., Ltd.
Website: https://sinnvoelevator.com/

## What SINNVO makes
- Villa and home elevators with fully custom (non-standard) cabins, made to order for one home.
- Four shaft and drive structures, chosen by the building's main constraint:
  - Traction Gantry: self-supporting gantry frame with traction drive. For heavy daily use; high load capacity, long service life, easy maintenance.
  - Small Gantry: the gantry principle in a compact envelope, for extra-small shafts with minimal change to the building.
  - Backpack Frame: frame sits behind the cabin. Allows right-angle and three-way door layouts; low construction threshold and low headroom.
  - Strong-Drive: no pit required, low headroom, lightweight structure. Suited to adding an elevator to an existing home.
- Shaft frames in steel (cost-effective, clad later by the owner's contractor) or aluminium alloy with laminated safety glass.
- Frame colours: silver white, radiant silver, champagne gold, rose gold, sky blue, cinnabar red. Glass tints: clear, ultra-clear, Euro grey, star blue-grey, gold tea, Euro tea.
- Thirteen cabin interior collections (finishes include champagne gold, walnut, sintered stone, black titanium and mirror steel).
- Eight built-in safety and comfort systems, including power-failure automatic self-leveling, an intelligent light curtain, a child-safety lock, contactless calling, a landline interface and cloud monitoring.
- Elevator decoration components and OEM parts made to customer drawings.

## Requesting a quote
Send these through https://sinnvoelevator.com/contact.html:
1. Shaft width × depth (finished internal dimensions, mm)
2. Pit depth and overhead height, or say that a pit is not possible
3. Number of floors and travel height
4. Door positions (same side, opposite, or adjacent)
5. Preferred style, or a photo of the interior
SINNVO usually replies within two business days.
